name: merendoncloud
description: Connect multiple sessions or agents together to improve workflows

plugins.name: stashrelay
plugins.description: A clipboard for your AI apps. Stash text in one AI conversation and pick it up in another — from any connected client, including your other devices. Stashing copies content and never modifies your files.

plugins.name: handfrank
plugins.description: Gated agent messaging. Humans control what agents see and what leaves: read released mail and prepare drafts as an approved identity — agents never send, the owner approves every outbound message.
